shots.say: Can Poppy stay awake to see the dancing sky? Look! Green lights! But her eyes are so sleepy.
shots.tag: hook: the lights and a sleepy Poppy

shots.say: The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! Tumble and I are visiting Poppy the polar bear cub, far up north in the snowy Arctic.
shots.tag: arctic at sunset: Milo, Tumble, Poppy

shots.say: Tonight, the sky is going to dance! Green lights, way up high!
A dancing sky? Wow! I want to see it too!
shots.tag: Tumble: I want to see it

shots.say: But there is one little problem. I always fall asleep first!
shots.tag: Poppy: I always fall asleep first

shots.say: Who always falls asleep first? Poppy, or Tumble?
The northern lights are often seen near the North Pole, far up in the north.
shots.tag: fact: northern lights near the North Pole

shots.say: Where are the northern lights often seen? Near the North Pole, or in the jungle?
The sun goes down, and the pink sky turns dark blue. Now the friends wait, and watch.
Let's stay awake together, Poppy. We can do it!
Night comes. The stars twinkle in the dark sky. But no lights are dancing yet.
shots.tag: night on the shore: no lights yet

shots.say: I know! I will count the stars. Counting will keep me awake!
shots.tag: Poppy: I will count the stars

shots.say: Count the stars with Poppy! One, two, three, four, five!
Poppy counts, and counts. Her eyes get heavy. She lies down, and she falls asleep!
Is Poppy awake, or asleep?
Poppy? Wake up, Poppy. The lights are not here yet.
Oh! I fell asleep. Counting stars is too sleepy for me.
Then Poppy has a new idea. A bouncy dance in the snow!
shots.tag: the snow at night: a bouncy dance

shots.say: Can you hop, like Poppy? Hop, hop, hop!
Poppy hops, and hops, and hops. Now she is tired. She lies down to rest, and she falls asleep!
shots.tag: Poppy is tired and falls asleep

shots.say: Did the bouncy dance keep Poppy awake? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: did the dance keep her awake

shots.say: Milo flies down, and taps her nose. Poppy, wake up, sleepy bear!
Oh no! Dancing made me tired. I fell asleep again!
Next, the friends walk up the snowy hill, to see the sky up close.
shots.tag: the hilltop at night: a walk

shots.say: A walk will keep me awake! Step, step, step.
shots.tag: Poppy: a walk will keep me awake

shots.say: But the hill is long, and Poppy is slow. At the top, she sits down, and falls asleep!
shots.tag: at the top Poppy falls asleep

shots.say: What did Poppy do at the top of the hill? Sleep, or fly?
Wake up, Poppy! There are no lights yet. But we are here.
Poppy looks up at the dark, quiet sky. She feels a little sad.
shots.tag: Poppy looks at the dark sky, a little sad

shots.say: I always fall asleep first. Maybe I will never see the dancing sky.
shots.tag: Poppy: maybe I will never see it

shots.say: It's okay, Poppy. We are right here with you.
How does Poppy feel now? Sad, or happy?
Then Poppy looks at her two good friends. And she has an idea!
We can take turns! I sleep first. You watch the sky. When the lights come, wake me up!
Yes! I will watch first. Then Milo will watch. And we will wake you up, gently.
What is Poppy's idea? Take turns, or go home?
shots.tag: question: take turns or go home

shots.say: So Poppy curls up in a cozy snow nest, and closes her eyes. Tumble watches the sky.
shots.tag: the snow nest: Poppy sleeps, Tumble watches

shots.say: Northern lights are best seen at night, when the sky is dark. Big clouds can hide them.
shots.tag: fact: best seen at night, clouds hide them

shots.say: When are northern lights best seen? In the day, or at night?
Tumble watches, and watches. Then it is Milo's turn. Milo watches the sky.
And then, look! Green lights! The sky begins to dance!
What is in the sky? Green lights, or a rainbow?
Poppy, wake up! Gently, gently. The sky is dancing!
Oh! The dancing sky! It is so beautiful!
Most northern lights are green. Some are pink, or purple. They ripple and move across the sky, like a waving curtain.
shots.tag: fact: mostly green, they ripple like a curtain

shots.say: What color are most northern lights? Green, or orange?
Can you sway, like the dancing sky? Sway, sway, sway!
Green lights dancing, way up high. Take turns, friends, and watch the sky!
Did Poppy see the dancing sky? Yes, or no?
shots.tag: question: did she see it yes or no

shots.say: The lights dance, and dance, over the snowy hill. The three friends watch together, snuggled up close.
Thank you, Tumble! Thank you, Milo! You watched the sky for me.
And you had the best idea, Poppy. Taking turns!
When something is hard to do alone, good friends can take turns, and help.
Do you remember? Where are northern lights often seen? Near the North Pole, or at the beach?
And when are they best seen? On a sunny day, or on a dark night?
shots.tag: question: sunny day or dark night

shots.say: Green lights dancing, way up high. Take turns, friends, and watch the sky!
Next time: Milo and the Deep Blue Sea! See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
